Royal Jelly BenefitsAs a natural source of many nutrients, royal jelly can help provide the body with many beneficial compounds. This bee product contains many proteins, vitamins, amino acids, and a beneficial bioactive compound called 10-HDA. Research suggests that 10-HDA helps to support overall health and vitality.*

California Gold Nutrition Royal Jelly features a 3:1 freeze dried royal jelly concentrate in veggie capsules. It is equivalent to 1500 mg of fresh royal jelly and contains a minimum of 6% 10-HDA. When taken as directed, this provides approximately a 4-month supply.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 capsule daily, with or without food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of the reach of children. Consult with a licensed physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Note: Bee-derived products may cause an allergic reaction in some people.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
